name: stripe_payments
description: Live Stripe payment data retrieval for financial operations. Requires query_type: recent_payments, failed_charges, customers, or subscriptions. Optional limit (max 25). Returns structured payment records, failure codes, customer data, or subscription status. Suitable for payment reconciliation, failure analysis, and billing audits.

query_type.description: Type of payment data to retrieve. Use recent_payments for latest transactions, failed_charges to investigate payment failures, customers for customer records, or subscriptions for billing and subscription status.

limit.description: Number of records to return. Defaults to 10. Maximum 25.
